$comment: Provenance manifest for the vendored Factur-X EN16931 XSD/Schematron resources in this directory. tests/test_resource_provenance.py asserts every file listed below is present and its SHA-256 matches. Do not edit a vendored artifact file without regenerating both its hash here and the wheelSource.sha256 below.
artifactLabel: Factur-X 1.09 EN16931 (XSD + compiled Schematron business rules)
artifactVersionNote: This is Factur-X 1.09, NOT ZUGFeRD 2.5.2 / Factur-X 1.09.2. The compiled Schematron stylesheet's own embedded title attribute reads 'Schema for Factur-X; 1.09; EN16931-COMPLIANT (FULLY)' (verified by inspecting Factur-X_1.09_EN16931.xsl directly, not inferred from the wheel's package version). The official ZUGFeRD 2.5.2 / Factur-X 1.09.2 corrigendum package (published by FeRD/FNFE-MPE on 2026-08-04, primarily affecting the EXTENDED profile) requires submitting real personal data through a registration form on ferd-net.de and fnfe-mpe.org -- there is no direct, ungated download. Per an explicit 2026-08-10 user decision, this round vendors the exact, independently content-verified, ungated Factur-X 1.09 EN16931 artifacts instead, and every claim in code, /capabilities, and documentation says '1.09', never '1.09.2'. Upgrading EN16931 to the true 1.09.2 corrigendum artifacts (if it differs from 1.09 for EN16931 at all -- FeRD's own release note says the corrigendum 'primarily' affects EXTENDED) is a follow-up once someone completes that registration and hands over the official ZIP.

wheelSource.sha256VerifiedAgainst: PyPI JSON API 'digests.sha256' for this exact release file, fetched independently of the local pip download
wheelSource.license: BSD-3-Clause-style (see upstream LICENSE.txt, identical in text to this repository's own LICENSE file -- this repository is itself a fork of the same akretion/factur-x project)
wheelSource.note: Only the 6 files listed below (from wheelPath facturx/xsd_and_schematron/facturx-en16931/) were copied. No other file from the wheel, and no dependency edge on the 'factur-x' PyPI package, was added -- see facturx/phase1/validate/structured.py and schematron.py module docstrings for why (this repository's own package is also named 'facturx', a name collision with upstream). The wheel's bundled files carry no individual per-file license headers; provenance for each is this manifest entry plus the wheel-level BSD license above.

files.role: Root XSD for the EN16931 profile; imports the three urn_un_unece_... files below.
Imported reusable aggregate business information entity definitions.

Compiled ISO Schematron business-rule stylesheet (XSLT 2.0, requires an XSLT2-capable engine -- executed offline via pinned saxonche/SaxonC-HE). Embedded title: 'Schema for Factur-X; 1.09; EN16931-COMPLIANT (FULLY)'. Contains 427 svrl:failed-assert templates (424 unflagged/blocking BR-*, BR-CO-*, BR-S-*, BR-DEC-* assertions; 3 flag="warning" PEPPOL-EN16931-R00x advisory assertions). The only external-resource access in the whole file is a fixed relative document('FACTUR-X_EN16931_codedb.xml') call (116 occurrences, always the same literal filename, resolved by the XSLT engine against this stylesheet's own location -- never derived from the invoice being checked).

Code-list lookup table (enumeration values) referenced by Factur-X_1.09_EN16931.xsl via document(). Required at execution time -- schematron.py fails the control safely (not_reliable, never passed) if this file is missing or unreadable, verified directly (see tests/test_schematron.py::test_missing_codedb_fails_safely).

executionEngine.license: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (Saxon-HE), no license key required, no Java runtime, no network access at runtime
executionEngine.why: The compiled Schematron stylesheet declares <xsl:stylesheet version="2.0">, i.e. genuine XSLT 2.0, which lxml/libxslt cannot execute (1.0 only). saxonche is Saxonica's own offline, open-source Python binding for SaxonC-HE and needs no external service (unlike upstream factur-x's own convenience wrapper, which per its docs can call out to a remote 'Saxon Server' -- that code path is not used here at all; this integration calls the SaxonC-HE engine in-process).
